scope: NPU specialization for exact axis-aligned uniform unblended or opaque source-over rectangles
optimization: Validate the two-triangle rectangle shape; quantize color once on NPU; compute NPU coverage with comparisons; use exact integer-valued FP16 byte selection in groups of four pixels. Coverage-mask counting on the host is diagnostic only.
limitations: No interpolated varying or texture shading
No transparent blend specialization; existing general NPU triangle path remains
No live installed-driver or desktop frame delivery in these tests
Timing is diagnostic, not a controlled frame-rate benchmark
larger_batches: Uniform pipeline now rejects batch >4096 after prior 65536-sample device-loss experiment
rejected_variant: NPU compiler rejected integer ReduceSum over the entire coverage plane. Validated implementation returns a mask for host diagnostics instead.
